parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **SourceType** is set to **OSS**. The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: CreateTime
parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **SourceType** is set to **NAS**. The time when the file system was created. UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **SourceType** is set to **NAS**. The ID of the file system.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: The data source type. Only free trial information of OSS backup and NAS backup can be queried.
